lead_raw_text:
The structure of Tm2CdSe4 crystallizes in the orthorhombic space group Cmmm (No. 194), with a unit cell containing 14 atoms—Tm4Cd2Se8—distributed over four independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows Cd in a tetrahedral environment with four Se neighbors, while Tm adopts a six-coordinate Se environment and Se centers have four geometric neighbors (one Cd, three Se). The periodic neighbor graph is fully connected in three dimensions. Validated polyhedron-sharing analysis indicates corner-sharing between Cd tetrahedra and between Cd tetrahedra and Tm six-vertex coordination polyhedra.
